headline: PSEi slumps to new 6.5-year low
summary: The PSEi shed 0.62% to close at 5,477.91, a fresh six-and-a-half-year low. Losses in five of six sectors outweighed modest foreign buying, while the All Shares index fell 0.66%.
why: The PSEi is the benchmark index of the Philippine Stock Exchange, and its level reflects investor sentiment toward the country's economy and listed companies.
why_moved: Losses in five of six sectors outweighed modest foreign buying, pushing the index down 0.62%.
